meta: Take one photo, ask one question: AI can read the words, numbers and tables in a photo and explain them to you like a real person. Here's how AI "sees" a picture.
prompt: Please explain this to me. Is there anything I should watch out for?

muc.title: A bill you just can't figure out
muc.text: This month's power bill is unusually high, and no matter how many times you read it, you can't see how they got that number.

muc.title: Take one photo, ask one question
muc.text: Now you can just take a photo, send it to AI, and ask like you'd ask a real person. It can read words, numbers and tables in the photo.

muc.title: How does AI see a picture?
muc.text: To AI, a picture is cut into many small squares, and each square is like a word. It reads those squares together with your question, then answers.

muc.title: Just snap and ask
muc.text: Bills, contracts, menus in another language, charts, even the error light on your washing machine: just snap a photo and ask.

muc.title: Clear photos get read correctly
muc.text: The clearer and straighter the photo, the more accurately AI reads it.

muc.title: Important matters: ask an expert
muc.text: For medicine or legal papers, AI helps you understand fast, but the final call should still come from an expert. And cover account numbers and ID numbers before you take the photo.

muc.title: Snap a paper you find confusing
muc.text: Take a photo of a paper you find confusing, send it to AI and ask "please explain this to me, is there anything I should watch out for?".
